description: Runway ends. PROVISIONAL DRAFT 24-10-2026: Canberra has two runways, 17/35 and 12/30. Headings are magnetic, the same reference as the other packs and the weather reports. They are the SkyVector and Flight Plan Database figures (168/348 and 117/297, the two sources agreeing to half a degree), consistent with true bearings worked from the threshold coordinates less the 12 degrees east variation in the ERSA entry. Not checked against the AIP.
